title.narrative: IHS Kenya Green Housing Partnership LLP

description.narrative: Investment in affordable, green housing developments in Kenya managed by International Housing Solutions, an established investor in and manager of affordable housing in Southern Africa.

The Fund invests in rental and for sale housing developments comprising of units valued at no more than KES 4.5 million each (adjusted to KES 5,008,608 (incl. VAT) for 2022 investments to account for inflation), predominantly in and around Nairobi. All developments conform to IFC’s EDGE environmental standards, and the Fund works with established developers to develop properties matching its investment requirements. Once the properties have been acquired, the Fund will utilise IHS' in-house resources to manage the portfolio properties and to facilitate their eventual disposal.

activity-date.narrative: The Fund’s exit strategy is largely determined by the type of development. Ad hoc sales are expected to generate distributions to investors during the latter part of the Fund’s life and rental developments are intended to be disposed of into long-term investment vehicles suitable for institutional investors, such as REITs, towards the end of the Fund’s life.
